proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureActivationCost { kind: 'action' }
proposed_widenings.justification: Preserve Life uses 'a Magic action', which costs the turn's Action. Current ClassFeatureActivationCost only has 'free' and 'bonus_action' variants; there is no 'action' (or 'magic') option.
proposed_widenings.evidence: As a Magic action, you present your Holy Symbol and expend a use of your Channel Divinity…

proposed_widenings.name: HealHpEffect multi-target pool variant
proposed_widenings.justification: Preserve Life generates a total HP pool (5 × cleric level) and distributes it across multiple chosen targets. The current HealHpEffect only supports target: 'self' | 'target_creature' (single target with a fixed/scaled per-target amount). A pool-allocation variant is needed: total_pool distributed among N chosen creatures.
proposed_widenings.evidence: …evoke healing energy that can restore a number of Hit Points equal to five times your Cleric level. Choose Bloodied creatures within 30 feet of yourself…and divide those Hit Points among them.

proposed_widenings.name: DiceAmount flat-scalar variant (or DiceExpr with dice:0 allowed)
proposed_widenings.justification: The heal pool is '5 × cleric level' — a purely flat numeric value with no dice. DiceExpr requires non-optional dice and dieSize fields; encoding 0d1 + 5/level is semantically dishonest. A flat_per_level shape or explicit flat-only DiceExpr is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: …restore a number of Hit Points equal to five times your Cleric level.

proposed_widenings.name: TargetFilter { kind: 'bloodied' } on target selection
proposed_widenings.justification: Targets must be Bloodied (≤ half max HP). No TargetFilter or targeting predicate concept exists in the surface. This is a hard eligibility constraint, not a soft choice.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose Bloodied creatures within 30 feet of yourself…

proposed_widenings.name: HealHpEffect.cap: 'half_max_hp'
proposed_widenings.justification: The heal to any single creature is capped at 'no more than half its Hit Point maximum'. The current HealHpEffect has no cap field.
proposed_widenings.evidence: This feature can restore a creature to no more than half its Hit Point maximum.

notes: Five distinct surface gaps prevent honest encoding. The most immediately blocking is the missing 'action' (Magic action) activation cost variant — typecheck would fail without it. The heal effect itself requires a new family: a total-HP-pool distributed across filtered targets with a per-target cap, which is structurally different from the existing single-target heal_hp. No dhall, json, or trace written.
